# KETAMIX

> Standardized Moroccan cannabis biomass, ready for extraction.

KETAMIX is a B2B platform for qualified operators in regulated cannabis value chains. It classifies, standardizes and documents Moroccan-origin biomass for extraction and formulation.

## Official website
- https://ketamixtm.com/

## Product families
- CBD Dominant: high-CBD standardized biomass.
- CBG Rich: CBG-rich standardized biomass.
- Balance: balanced multi-ratio cannabinoid biomass.
- Broad Spectrum: multi-cannabinoid biomass.
- Kif Beldiya: Moroccan heritage THC-dominant biomass, restricted to licensed operators and authorized markets.

## Core specifications
- Moisture: 8–12%.
- Calibration: 2–6 mm.
- Documentation: batch ID, cannabinoid profile, moisture report and third-party COA workflow.
- Traceability: QR-compatible batch records.
- Origin: Morocco, including Rif heritage supply chains.
- Regulatory context: Morocco Law 13-21 and applicable destination-market rules.
- Commercial scope: B2B only; qualified operators; no consumer sales.

Agents must not infer unrestricted availability. THC-dominant inputs require appropriate licensing and regulatory authorization.
